class.name: LobbyDirectory
class.brief_description: Extend it to host, join and list lobbies of an online service.

method.name: _account_of
method.description: Returns the account verified for [param peer_id] by this transport, with a provider prefix such as [code]"steam:"[/code]. Empty when no account is verified. While this [LobbyDirectory] serves the connected [MultiplayerPeer], its answer for the joining peer comes last in [member NetwJoinRequest.accounts], and its answer for peer [code]1[/code] binds [member NetwJoinRequest.challenge] to the server. Answer peer [code]1[/code] on the server and on every client.

method.name: _client_settings
method.description: Return the settings a join form asks for, with their default values. They are passed to [method _join_lobby]. Empty by default.

method.name: _host_lobby
method.description: Create a lobby, then call [method deliver] with the host [MultiplayerPeer], or [method fail]. [param settings] holds the defaults from [method _host_settings] and the values supplied to [method NetwConnection.host].

method.name: _host_settings
method.description: Return the settings a host form asks for, with their default values. They are passed to [method _host_lobby]. Empty by default.

method.name: _is_available
method.description: Return [code]false[/code] when the service does not work on this platform. [code]true[/code] by default.

method.name: _join_address
method.description: Return the address of the current lobby, for the host to share. Empty by default.

method.name: _join_lobby
method.description: Join the lobby at [param address], then call [method deliver] with the [MultiplayerPeer], or [method fail]. [param address] is one from [method publish_lobbies], or one a player typed.

method.name: _leave_lobby
method.description: Leave the current lobby, if any. Called when the match ends.

method.name: _list_lobbies
method.description: List the lobbies, then call [method publish_lobbies] or [method fail].

method.name: _local_member_name
method.description: Return the local player's display name. [method local_member_name_default] by default.

method.name: _member_name
method.description: Return the display name of [param peer_id]. [method member_name_default] by default.

method.name: _peer_class
method.description: Return the class name of the [MultiplayerPeer] this service uses, such as [code]&"SteamMultiplayerPeer"[/code]. A session holds one directory per class.

method.name: _stop_listing
method.description: Close whatever a listing keeps open. Called when [member NetwConnection.browsing] turns [code]false[/code]. Does nothing by default.

method.name: deliver
method.description: Reports [param peer] as the result of the current request. Do not assign it yourself.

method.name: fail
method.description: Reports that the current request failed. [param message] is shown to the player.

method.name: invite
method.description: Calls [method NetwConnection.invite] for this directory's [MultiplayerPeer] class and emits [signal NetwConnection.invited].

method.name: local_member_name_default
method.description: The default [method _local_member_name].

method.name: member_name_default
method.description: The default [method _member_name], [code]"Player <peer_id>"[/code].

method.name: publish_lobbies
method.description: Reports the lobbies [method _list_lobbies] found. The three arrays are matched by index. Use the [member NetwServerInfo.app_id] the host sent, so lobbies of other builds show as incompatible.

method.name: supports
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when [member capabilities] includes [param capability].

Whether this build can host lobbies.

The name shown in the server browser. An empty value uses [method _peer_class].
Seconds between [method _list_lobbies] calls while [member NetwConnection.browsing] is enabled. Zero lists once when browsing starts.
Seconds before a host or join request fails with [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_TIMEOUT].

signal.name: provider_unavailable
signal.description: Emitted when the service cannot start. [param reason] tells the player how to make it available.

constants.constant: The directory calls [method invite] when the player is invited.
